proof_0145.moves: Case-splits on the decidable proposition P: in the true branch both sides are F.map (f h), in the false branch both are F.map (g h), so each branch closes by reflexivity. The real content is the dite case split, not any cited lemma; the tactic packages it into an opaque auxiliary proof term.

proof_0146.moves: An auto-generated projection lemma for the counit isomorphism of the equivalence prodμ (built from associators and a braiding on product categories). The proof just unfolds the composite equivalence componentwise and cancels identity compositions; everything else is simp's congruence/transitivity residue.

proof_0147.moves: Builds the Trichotomous instance for < on Char: given that neither a < b nor b < a, convert both negations into the corresponding ≤ facts and conclude a = b by antisymmetry.

proof_0148.moves: Two halves. Lower bound: for x in s, u x lies in u''s so a ≤ u x, and the adjunction l_le turns that into l a ≤ x. Greatest: for any lower bound x of s, monotone u carries it to a lower bound of u''s, so u x ≤ a; apply monotone l and compose with x ≤ l (u x) by transitivity. The two halves are packaged with an anonymous constructor.

proof_0149.moves: A mechanically reassociated variant of comp_hom_hom: take the base equality, whisker it on the right with an arbitrary morphism, and reassociate. No new mathematics; the reassoc machinery plus associativity is the whole proof.

proof_0150.moves: Purely definitional: the forgetful functor from commutative groups to groups leaves the underlying object and its monoid unit untouched, so the unit of the image is literally the same morphism. Closed by rfl.

proof_0151.moves: Definitional computation of a custom recursor: notNilRec pattern-matches on the walk, and on a cons walk the match takes its cons branch, so the two sides are the same term. The whole proof is rfl.

proof_0152.moves: A rewriting chain: rewrite backwards along the second hypothesis, expand eval on a cons on both sides into (zpow' r x) * eval of the tail, then rewrite the tail with the first hypothesis. The content is the eval_cons unfolding plus substitution of the two hypotheses.

proof_0153.moves: Both sides unfold to the same set of points whose value under the composite partial function lands in s; the set equality is proved by extensionality and pushed through automation. No named mathematical lemma is invoked.

proof_0154.moves: Dualization argument: an order-connected subset of the order dual is again order-connected, so the already-proved strongly-atomic result applies there, and the iff relating strong atomicity of the dual to strong coatomicity transports it back.

proof_0155.moves: The pointwise zero set is definitionally the singleton {0}, so smallness follows immediately from the fact that a singleton is small. One application, nothing else.

proof_0156.moves: Functoriality: the two functor images compose to the image of f.hom ≫ f.inv, which is the identity since f is an isomorphism, and a functor sends identities to identities. Simp does this via the map_hom_inv_id lemma; the rest is closing residue.

proof_0157.moves: Pure symmetry shuffling: swap the two arguments of Disjoint and the two arguments of the sup so the goal becomes the already-proved mirror statement, and massage the hypotheses the same way. The modularity is used only inside the lemma being invoked.

proof_0158.moves: An auto-generated component lemma: the inverse of the comparison isomorphism between successive pullbacks and pullback along the composite is defined to be the identity at every index, so the statement holds by rfl.

proof_0159.moves: gcd a 1 divides 1 (being the gcd, it divides the right argument), and a divisor of 1 is a unit. Two lemma applications, nothing more.

proof_0160.moves: Inversion in a commutative division monoid is itself a monoid homomorphism, so the general fact that multiset products commute with monoid homs applies directly. The witness is exhibiting inv as a bundled hom.

proof_0161.moves: Unfold mulSingle into an update of the constant-one function, then the general lemma comparing an updated function with the function itself reduces the pointwise inequality to the inequality at the single index. Everything else is simp closing residue.

proof_0162.moves: Rewrite chain: commute the two set-differences so that a \ a appears, that collapses to bottom, and bottom minus anything is bottom.

proof_0163.moves: Delegation: invoke the decidability-hypothesis version of the same statement, supplying classical decidability of the relevant proposition. The only real step is removing the decidability assumption.

proof_0164.moves: Auto-generated iff form of an extensionality lemma. Forward direction: substitute along the equality of the two structures and everything is reflexively equal (with heterogeneous-equality bookkeeping for the dependent fields). Backward direction: apply the ext lemma. The proof is splitting the iff and doing cases on an equality.

proof_0165.moves: Definitional: the comap of a subgroup along a multiplicative equivalence is built by pulling back the carrier, and the underlying submonoid is the same carrier, so both sides are the same term. Closed by rfl.

proof_0166.moves: There is no argument here at all: this is the structure-field accessor of the DividedPowers structure, whose dpow_one axiom states that the first divided power of an element of the ideal is the element itself. Nothing is proved.

proof_0167.moves: Destruct both sigma pairs and case-split on the trichotomy of the base relation: if the indices are related, use the left constructor of the lexicographic order; if they are equal, substitute along that equality and use trichotomy in the fiber to produce the right constructor or equality. The case analysis and the two constructors are the content.

proof_0168.moves: Definitional: psigmaCongrRight applied to the constant family of identity equivalences produces, field by field, exactly the identity equivalence on the dependent pair type, so the two are the same term. Closed by rfl.
